responsibility: Declares the abstract pending_diagnostic and pending_note interfaces that let the analyzer save diagnostics until after graph construction. It defines the comparison, emission, path-termination, wording-customization, path-event customization, supercession, and interesting-region hooks used by warning kinds, as well as the evdesc helper bundles passed to precision-of-wording callbacks and CRTP helpers for implementing subclass equality.
same_name_distinction: Defines the abstract pending_diagnostic and pending_note interfaces, helper descriptor types, and CRTP equality helpers that warning subclasses use; unlike pending-diagnostic.cc, it establishes the customization hooks rather than the common default implementations.
